answered_status_code.description: Stored host status code selected for the sealed terminal decision (logins.http_status: the configured OK/Fail/InternalError code; 200 for nginx-style answers, also for rejections). It is not the committed transport status (context.transport_status) and never a result: read outcome. Null when no terminal decision was sealed.

answered_status_message.description: Stored status text the host answered the authentication caller with (logins.status_msg). IdP browser pages render their own localized text, so this is not necessarily what a user saw. Null when no terminal decision was sealed.
